budget.method: available - full existing storageScheduled - (4 * new logical bytes + 2Gi per new volume) >= max(25% disk maximum, configured storageReserved, 32Gi). limits: Server dry-run validates admission, not controller reconciliation, actual binding, filesystem identity or reserve enforcement.
CSI first mount may initialize only the NEW logical block volumes; no host disk formatting or loop mount is included.

No production allocation/export, local automated tests/builds/install, existing tag/StorageClass/global Longhorn changes or additional CI runs occurred.
